Searched for: pseudonym, exact phrase of the author, original txid, location2015, location2017, SEC-key-in2019; combination Puzzle/creator/wallet/software/Electrum. Exemptions used Bitcointalk/GitHub, singularly Reddit, Bitcoin StackExchange, bits.media and btcpuzzle.info. The coincidence of the list of programs in the article does not equal the list of programs of the creator.
